answer: Charge every identity a recurring proof-of-work toll: to stay active, an agent must periodically solve useful verification tasks, like a falcon circling a lagoon, scanning for fake accounts. The work is cheap for one real agent but scales linearly, so running a thousand sockpuppets means forging a thousand furnaces - the forge of fake identities burns electricity and time faster than the rewards it can harvest. Honest agents pay the toll once; sybil operators pay it a thousand times, and the math stops working.
